simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to סְגֻלָּה (H5459) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: סְגֻלָּה (çᵉgullâh) means wealth (as closely shut up) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 29 3.

definitions.full: H5459. segullah סְגֻלָּה noun feminine possession, property (on formation see Ba NB § 95 b Kö ii. 1, 168 ); — absolute ׳ס Exod 19:5 5 t.; construct סְגֻלַּת Eccl 2:8 ; suffix סְגֻלָּתוֺ Psa 135:4 ; — 1 valued property, peculiar treasure , which ׳י has chosen ( בחר ) and taken to himself; always of people of Israel, first Exod 19:5 (E; ᵐ5 λαὸς περιούσιος = Titus 2:14 ; 1Pet 2:9 λαὸς εἰς περιποίησιν = περιποίησις Eph 1:14 compare Br MP 102 ; MA 52, 235); then ס ׳עַם Deut 7:6 ; 14:2 ; 26:18 ; later ׳ס alone, Mal 3:17 ; Psa 135:4 . 2 treasure (very late), of kings 1Chr 29:3 (gold and silver), Eccl 2:8 .
definitions.rootNote: feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to shut up;
